body: The best OSS video generation models, created by Genmo
plain_description: **Create videos from text prompts with an open video generation model.** Try it in the included playground or generate videos from the command line. Fine-tune it on your own videos with LoRA.
technical_description: Mochi 1 is Genmo’s open text-to-video model, with a 10-billion-parameter Asymmetric Diffusion Transformer and an accompanying video autoencoder. The repository provides a Gradio UI, command-line generation, a programmatic Python API, and LoRA fine-tuning. It requires Python 3.11 or newer; the README recommends at least one H100 GPU and says single-GPU inference needs approximately 60 GB of VRAM.
title: Mochi 1
